title: ManpowerGroup Reports 3rd Quarter 2026 Results
summary: The Investor Relations website contains information about ManpowerGroup Inc.'s business for stockholders, potential investors, and financial analysts.
body_markdown:
- Revenues of $4.8 billion (+4% as reported, +5% constant currency, +6% organic constant currency)
- Continued top-line growth driven by strength in Manpower, particularly in the United States
- Improving global Experis trends with U.S. Experis crossing over to growth during the quarter
- Strong year-over-year revenue growth and Operating Unit Profit improvement in Northern Europe
- SG&A improved trend reflects continued cost actions
- Becky Frankiewicz will become CEO January 1, 2027, with Jonas Prising transitioning to Executive Chair. More details in a separate press release issued this morning


MILWAUKEE


, Oct. 15, 2026


/PRNewswire/ -- ManpowerGroup (NYSE: MAN) today reported net earnings of $0.71 per diluted share for the three months ended September 30, 2026 compared to net earnings of $0.38 per diluted share in the prior year period. Net earnings in the quarter were $34.1 million compared to net earnings of $18.0 million a year earlier. Revenues for the third quarter were $4.8 billion, a 4% increase from the prior year period.


The current year quarter included restructuring costs, strategic transformation program costs, a business sale adjustment, and Argentina hyperinflationary related non-cash currency translation losses, which negatively impacted earnings per share by $0.30 in the third quarter. Excluding these items, earnings per share was $1.01 per diluted share in the quarter representing an increase of 24% in constant currency in the third quarter of 2026.1


Financial results in the quarter were also impacted by the U.S. dollar relative to foreign currencies compared to the prior year period. On a constant currency basis, revenues increased 5% compared to the prior year period.


Jonas Prising, ManpowerGroup Chair & CEO, said, "We delivered another quarter of consistent performance and strong execution as momentum continues across the organization. Our Manpower brand continues to lead the way, with notable share gains in the U.S. Our Experis and Talent Solutions brands experienced sequential revenue trend improvement which is encouraging. Our performance to date reinforces our confidence that 2026 is an inflection point for the business. At the same time, we continue to advance our transformation, expanding implementation beyond the U.S. and driving growth across our brands and regions while remaining on track to deliver on our cost savings target. Looking ahead, the combination of improving demand, strong execution, and continued progress on our transformation positions ManpowerGroup to drive sustainable, profitable growth."


We anticipate diluted earnings per share in the fourth quarter will be between $1.03 and $1.13 and a 44% effective tax rate."


Net earnings for the nine months ended September 30, 2026 were $90.1 million, or net earnings of $1.89 per diluted share compared to net losses of $43.5 million, or net losses of $0.93 per diluted share in the prior year, respectively. The current year-to-date period included restructuring costs, strategic transformation program costs, the sale of our Jefferson Wells U.S. business, a discontinued business liquidation charge, and Argentina hyperinflationary related non-cash currency translation losses which, in aggregate, reduced earnings per share by $0.62. Excluding the net impact of these charges, earnings per share for the nine-month period was $2.51 per diluted share representing an increase of 21%2 in constant currency. Revenues for the nine-month period were $14.2 billion, representing an increase of 7% compared to the prior year or 5% in constant currency.


In conjunction with its third quarter earnings release, ManpowerGroup will broadcast its conference call live over the internet on October 15, 2026 at 7:30 a.m. Central time (8:30 a.m. Eastern time). Prepared remarks for the conference call, webcast details, presentation and recordings are included within the Investor Relations section of[manpowergroup.com](http://manpowergroup.com/) .


Supplemental financial information referenced in the conference call can be found at[http://investor.manpowergroup.com/](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4798300-1&h=398921327&u=http%3A%2F%2Finvestor.manpowergroup.com%2F&a=http%3A%2F%2Finvestor.manpowergroup.com%2F) .

**About ManpowerGroup** ManpowerGroup® (NYSE: MAN), the leading global workforce solutions company, helps organizations transform in a fast-changing world of work by sourcing, assessing, developing, and managing the talent that enables them to win. We develop innovative solutions for hundreds of thousands of organizations every year, providing them with skilled talent while finding meaningful, sustainable employment for millions of people across a wide range of industries and skills. Our expert family of brands – Manpower, Experis, and Talent Solutions – creates substantially more value for candidates and clients across more than 70 countries and territories and has done so for more than 75 years. We are recognized consistently for our diversity – as a best place to work for Women, Inclusion, Equality, and Disability, and in 2026 ManpowerGroup was named one of the World's Most Ethical Companies for the 17th time – all confirming our position as the brand of choice for in-demand talent. For more information, visit[www.manpowergroup.com](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4798300-1&h=2833550959&u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.manpowergroup.com%2F&a=www.manpowergroup.com) .


**Forward-Looking Statements** This press release contains forward-looking statements within the meaning of Section 27A of the Securities Act of 1933, as amended, and Section 21E of the Exchange Act of 1934, as amended, including statements regarding trends in labor demand and the future strengthening of such demand, the Company's financial outlook, and the Company's strategic initiatives and technology investments, including our ability to increase market share and the acceleration of transformation initiatives to remove structural costs from the organization to drive efficiencies, which are subject to risks and uncertainties. The Company's actual results may differ materially from those described or contemplated in the forward-looking statements due to numerous factors. These factors include those found in the Company's reports filed with the SEC, including the information under the heading "Risk Factors" in its Annual Report on Form 10-K for the year ended December 31, 2025, which information is incorporated herein by reference.


We caution that any forward-looking statement reflects only our belief at the time the statement is made. The Company assumes no obligation to update or revise any forward-looking statements. We reference certain non-GAAP financial measures, which we believe provide useful information for investors. We include a reconciliation of these measures, where appropriate, to GAAP on the Investor Relations section of our website at[manpowergroup.com](http://manpowergroup.com/) .
